title: Muscle Strength, Physical Work Capacity and Functional Performance in Individuals With Down Syndrome
brief_summary: This project will evaluate muscle strength and its relationship to everyday function in individuals with Down Syndrome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Down Syndrome
* Mild or moderate mental retardation
* Able to tolerate exercise testing

Exclusion Criteria:

* Uncontrolled cardiovascular disease
* orthopedic limitations to exercise
